# nemau compute snapshot

A snapshot copies an instance's system disk to the object store, without
stopping it. Attached block volumes are never included. It is billed on the
bytes actually stored (the compressed archive), per GB and month.

Snapshots whose storage is "hypervisor" predate the object store: they can be
listed and deleted, are not billed, and cannot be restored.

Deleting an instance deletes its snapshots.

## Usage

```
nemau compute snapshot [command]
```

Aliases: `snapshots`, `snap`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](nemau_compute_snapshot_create.md) | Create a snapshot |
| [delete](nemau_compute_snapshot_delete.md) | Delete a snapshot |
| [list](nemau_compute_snapshot_list.md) | List the snapshots |
| [restore](nemau_compute_snapshot_restore.md) | Restore a snapshot onto its instance |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
